name: rubric-survey
description: Bilingual LLM-response evaluation rubric survey (Next.js + NestJS, SQLite, autosave, admin console)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: npm run sync-rubric && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run sync-rubric && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:prod" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
